permissions.subtitle: What KIVO may do, and how much it asks first.

mode.title: Permission mode
mode.ask: Asks before anything that changes something. Reading and looking never ask.
mode.accept-edits: Edits files and works with apps and windows on its own; asks before commands, settings and anything high-risk.
mode.plan: Only reads and looks. Shows a plan and changes nothing until you approve it; approving runs exactly those steps.
mode.auto: Does everyday things on its own. High-risk actions always ask.
mode.bypassLater: Bypass permissions arrives with its own confirmation step and time limit.
mode.switch: Switch anytime from the Island, the tray, chat or
